name: Microsoft Seven Hills (Station Road) Building 1 (SYD09)

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 57 Station Road (site-level; not building-specific)

builder.note: Microsoft Local: FDC Construction (NSW) Pty Ltd built Building One

mw_it.note: EIS: 'approved data centre has a data storage capacity of 1.2MW' / 'small scale 1.2MW data centre comprising 630sqm of GFA' (Table 7 lists 1.2MW as power consumption). Below the 5MW threshold

mw_grid.note: EIS Table 7 'Power Consumption' 1.2MW for DA-21-01058 building; 2 x 1.5MW + 1 x 1MW generators

reference.note: confirmed by EIS (source 8), CTMP (source 10) and Endeavour Energy referral CNR-24426 (source 11)

lodged.note: not confirmed; DA was under referral to Endeavour Energy by 22 July 2021 (source 11); PlanningAlerts lists a 57 Station Road application dated 8 Jun 2021 (source 6), probably this DA but not verified

determined.note: EIS: 'On 10 January 2022, development consent was granted under DA-21-01058 by Blacktown City Council'

jobs_operational.note: CTMP: 'There would be four staff on-site as part of the operation of SYD09'

construction_start.note: CTMP Table 3.1: demolition, earthworks and retaining walls under DA-21-01058 ('prior to SYD08 project') January-August 2022; building start date not stated

construction_end.note: Microsoft Local Dec 2023 update: 'Construction of Building One is complete. Building fit-out work is underway' (Jul 2023 update had estimated completion by July 2023)

open_questions: scope: Building 1 is SYD09, the 1.2MW (630 m2 GFA) 'Rapid Deployment' data centre approved by Blacktown City Council under DA-21-01058 on 10 Jan 2022 - below the 5MW threshold, so out of scope (kept for completeness; operates as one campus with SYD08)
